name: BNE Parity Lab
objective: Increase the globally earliest Battle.net Edition parity frontier without regressing any previously clean case.
priority: Investigate the globally earliest divergent cycle.
Prefer the experiment with the highest expected information gain per cost.
Prefer a native/Java causal twin over visible-state inference.
Minimize evidence before placing it in agent context.

required: focused case passes beyond its previous divergence
all 52 indexed campaign cases are present
triage and lab manifests verify every retained artifact
forbidden_shortcuts: using a partial survey as a full proof
editing or replacing a sealed native fixture
skipping an earlier divergence to work on a later case
declaring parity from a counterfactual state clamp

safe: offline native trace capture in an isolated harness directory
bounded counterfactual replay in the test trace harness
offline named predicate slicing from authenticated branch history
requires_human_or_agent_commit_decision: committing or merging a tournament winner
